failure.message: UpstreamUnavailable: None of the 1 watched software could be checked. GitHub returned 503 Service Unavailable three times.

advice.explanation: An agent could not finish its work.
advice.likely_cause: A service the agent reads from, such as GitHub, was unavailable or answered with an error.
advice.suggestion: Retry the run. If it fails again, check whether that service is up.
